ValidationRule.description: Synthetic UI2 accounts cannot take values that start Business Central sync, onboarding/financial emails, bell notifications or BAU generation. Applies to every user, including admins; not bypassed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Integration_Test_Record_CC__c, OR( NOT(ISBLANK(Business_Central_Customer_ID_CC__c)), Site_Synced_CC__c, Is_BAU_Account_CC__c, ISPICKVAL(Financial_Check_CC__c, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Financial_Check_CC__c, "Rejected"), ISPICKVAL(Client_Onboarding_Status_CC__c, "Completed") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: UI2 accounts are isolated: they cannot be synced to Business Central, set as BAU, or have Financial Check or Onboarding Status set.
